items.label: 孟什维克
items.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE complete transparent historical strategy-game adviser faction text icon, an artistic typographic identifier inspired by early-20th-century Russian political printed matter, not an asserted authentic party logo. Exact Cyrillic text on two closely stacked rows: top row «РС», bottom row «ДРП». Thus the full abbreviation is РСДРП. These FIVE letters must be correct, uppercase Cyrillic only, no quotation marks, no other characters. Use stout old Russian newspaper slab-serif capitals, nearly equal total row widths, broad strokes readable at only 20x20px. The letters themselves form the entire emblem: no book, no pen, no banner, no background plaque, no enclosing frame, no star or extra ornament. Letters in luminous pale yellow-gold metal with subtle amber engraved bevels and restrained historical-game painted texture. High overall brightness with broad lit faces, very little shadow, no deep 3D extrusion. A compact square composition filling 84 percent of the square, 8 percent transparent margin, genuine transparent background. Not cute, not modern corporate typography. Reference image is ONLY for gold palette and metal rendering.
